class.name: SteamInventoryChange
class.brief_description: The confirmed item rows returned by a Steam mutation.
class.description: The granted and changed rows carry the quantities Steam reports for the resulting stacks. Steam identifies fully removed stacks separately. A successful promotional or playtime claim can contain no changes.

method.name: get_granted
method.description: Returns the read-only array of item rows Steam granted or created.

method.name: get_changed
method.description: Returns the read-only array of existing item rows updated by Steam.

method.name: get_removed_instance_ids
method.description: Returns the decimal instance IDs Steam reports as removed.

members.member: The read-only array of item rows Steam granted or created.
